profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA. The harvested content focuses on Power Automate, which Microsoft describes as a tool to automate workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI-powered, digital, and robotic process automation. The site includes customer statements suggesting significant workforce reduction for data validation tasks achieved through generative AI and Power Automate, and references a Gartner Magic Quadrant for Robotic Process Automation report dated 23 June 2025, authored by Arthur Villa, Saikat Ray, Melanie Alexander, and Sachin Joshi.

Microsoft's tracked AI products span several categories, including Microsoft Power Automate AI for enterprise workflow automation with Copilot and data loss prevention integration, Microsoft Copilot embedded across Microsoft 365, Azure OpenAI Service providing OpenAI models within Azure with enterprise content filtering and Entra ID integration, and Azure Machine Learning as an MLOps platform with AutoML and a responsible AI toolkit. Additional products include AutoGen, a multi-agent conversation framework from Microsoft Research, Microsoft Designer for image and design generation, Microsoft Teams AI for meeting recaps and Copilot integration, SharePoint AI for enterprise content management, and Microsoft Clipchamp AI for video editing with auto-caption and text-to-speech features.

On the legal side, Microsoft is a named defendant in The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, and is associated with Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. in the same court. Microsoft files with the SEC under CIK 0000789019 and ticker MSFT, and its most recently recorded annual revenue, reported on a 10-K for the period ending 2026-06-30, was $331,839,000,000.
